parts.text: I work on the airspace desk at the platform company, keeping the shared picture of the airspace that includes the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones grouping them, and closures announced by the authorities. Closures can be planned with a start and end time or sudden, and they are often amended during the day, such as when an area is widened or an end time moves. When I enter a closure, I want to know how much disruption it caused across customers, and a closure can come into force while drones of several companies are already in the air.
